blocks.text: Ronnie Liang is now officially an Army Aviator, allowing him to fly aircraft operated by the Philippine Army Aviation Battalion. The singer and actor told select media on Friday, Oct. 30, that he received his aviation badge, or “wings,” last week after beginning his flight duties with the Army Aviation early this year. “I’m happy to announce na isa na po akong legit na Army Aviator o isang piloto sa Philippine Army Aviation Battalion. Nabigyan na po ako ng wings. Wings ang tawag namin dito,” he said. Liang began pursuing his dream of becoming a pilot in 2019 and obtained his […]...
